parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The toxins released by some pathogenic bacteria can be altered chemically so that they are harmless. These harmless toxins are called toxoids.

Toxoids are used in vaccines to provide protection against some infectious diseases.

Describe the response of the immune system to the injection of a toxoid.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is described as an autoimmune disease. It is a long-term condition that results from a failure of the immune system.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Explain why MG is known as an autoimmune disease.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest why MG is a long-term condition.
